We guarantee the prevention of the following manifestations of corruption:  
committing any actions contrary to the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan on combating corruption;  
unlawful use of official or service position for obtaining material or non-material benefit in personal interests or in the interests of third parties;  
preparation of procurement documentation for selection and tender in a manner contrary to legislation;  
conducting procurement procedures by the method of selection and tender in violation of legislative requirements;  
exerting influence on public procurement entities, including offering or promising a bribe, extortion, transfer of funds as a bribe, as well as consent to receive a bribe directly or indirectly;  
allowing a conflict of interest;  
collusion with other participants in the selection and tender;  
providing false or distorted information.  
If facts of corruption offenses are identified, we express my consent to being held liable in accordance with the legislation.

3. Sifatga qo'yiladigan talablar
Tovar yangi, nuqsonlarsiz, ishlab chiqarilgan yili 2026-yildan kam bo'lmagan boʻlishi kerak.
Davlat standartlariga muvofiqligi: GOST/TU talablariga mos kelishi shart.
Mahsulot boʻyicha muvofiqlik sertifikati va sifat pasportining mavjudligi.
Kafolat muddati va yaroqlilik muddati kamida 12 oyni tashkil etishi lozim.
